title: First day · "watch We Work Remotely for back-end roles" becomes a reader, a schedule and rows

steps.say: watch We Work Remotely for back-end roles
steps.reply:
I'm now watching We Work Remotely's Back-End Programming category. It checks every day at 09:00, or when your Mac next wakes if it was asleep then. The next check is tomorrow, 19 Oct.

The first read found 3 roles, now in a "Back-end jobs" table:
- **Staff Software Engineer, Revenue Systems**, Squarespace, full-time, anywhere in the world. Posted new.
- **Senior Java Developer**, Twikey, full-time, open to about 30 European countries. Posted new.
- **AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)**, Upgrade, full-time, anywhere in the world. Posted 3 days ago.

Each morning it will tell you which
